name: restful-template-backend
description: TypeScript Express API gateway for TZW LTD fire extinguisher microservices with PostgreSQL, Sequelize, JWT/OTP auth, RBAC, Swagger, reports, exports, Winston, Morgan, and express-validator.

scripts.dev:users: node init && npm run build && node dist/src/services/users/server.js
scripts.dev:extinguishers: node init && npm run build && node dist/src/services/extinguishers/server.js
scripts.dev:inspection-maintenance: node init && npm run build && node dist/src/services/inspectionMaintenance/server.js
